The check is missing: LAPACK-lite silently overrides explicit LAPACK paths or library names. I’ll make that combination fail with a clear error, whether the paths point to `gkylsoft` or a system installation. Having OpenBLAS installed alone is fine.

I also found a nearby typo that clears the MPI setting when LAPACK-lite is disabled; I’ll fix it and verify both behaviors.

Yes—the check was missing. I added it to [configure](/home/maxwell-rosen/gkeyll/configure:278): LAPACK-lite now rejects explicit external LAPACK settings, covering both `gkylsoft` and machine/cluster paths. Simply having OpenBLAS installed remains allowed.

Also fixed a nearby typo that disabled MPI when LAPACK-lite was off.

Verified shell syntax and 30 isolated configuration cases, including preservation of existing configuration files on failure.
